provenance.adaptation: single 600s native-frequency snapshot; all GET+PUT become reads
provenance.grouping: Frozen 640-bin joint L1 greedy split of native operation, global Zipf(0.99), and aligned byte probabilities in 4 windows; start with (2 MiB extent ceiling, active bitmap); stable sorting; at most 40 candidate boundaries per feature (32 evenly spaced plus 4 at either end); best gain > 1e-15; insertion serial breaks heap ties.
provenance.histogram_adaptation: old-bin all-window histograms distributed by member operation mass; full global histogram preserved, per-key xfer correlation approximated
provenance.key_identity: (block_id, host_name); key index follows first occurrence in source
provenance.operation_mapping: All GET and PUT become read; retain op_count multiplicity.
provenance.timeline: original temporal order removed; no window gating; no Zipf imposed

static_native.coverage: configured request shares, not measured file/object heat; no stopafter and no temporal replay
